title: prunus × donarium var. parvifolia
intro: Prunus × donarium var. parvifolia, commonly known as the Chinese plum, is a hybrid plant species that combines the characteristics of Prunus mume and Prunus salicina. The Chinese plum has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. Its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents present in the Chinese plum have been shown to exhibit anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-cardiovascular disease properties, highlighting its potential as a natural remedy for various health conditions.
